mostWorthwhile.text: Following fat through intestinal cells into lymph was most worthwhile. Packaging it as chylomicrons and sending it into the lacteal made its different route clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate glucose and amino acid crossings were clear but repetitive: both produced much the same result before joining in portal blood.

surprise.text: I expected to combine the absorbed fat directly with the packaging materials; the villus was required as the station, and the result explained that intestinal cells rebuild and package the fat.

arbitrary.text: Using the villus as a station made biological sense, but it was not obvious from the item names that the fat and packaging materials could not be combined directly. The compatibility feedback resolved it.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the absorbed nutrients are used. The contrasting blood and lymph routes gave the construction a clear purpose, though the repeated crossing steps were less engaging.
